name: chrome coin stamps a run of stats and claims
looks: The ring mark thickens into a glossy, slowly turning chrome coin. A sequence of short words and one big number hard-cut in front of it one after another, each a different proof point, with a couple of plain caption lines interleaved between stamps to connect them into a sentence.
build: A continuously rotating 3D coin driven by the master clock so it never resets across cuts; each word or number is cut exactly on the beat as its own layer with a drop shadow over the chrome, interleaved with hard-cut plain-caption beats on a flat dark field for the connecting words.
sound: A metallic clang on every stamp, pitched a little differently each time, with quieter dry ticks under the connecting caption beats.
prompt: Turn the brand's own mark into a slowly rotating chrome coin and hard-cut a short run of proof points in front of it, mixing one big number with a couple of short claim-words, stitched together by a plain caption line or two, so the whole run reads as the brand stamping its own credentials.
